title: Stonehenge Altar Stone: Origin Still a Mystery
paragraphs: Stonehenge is a famous ring of big stones in England. One stone is called the Altar Stone. It is about five metres long and very heavy.
People once thought it came from Wales. Later, scientists said it came from Scotland. Now a new study looks at this idea again.
The team studied the rock with many tests. They also used small pieces from museums. They did not find the same rock in Scotland. So the stone's home is still a mystery.

questions.q: Where did people once think it came from?
